Violence in northern Ethiopia pushing health system towards collapse: WHO (2 Nov 2026)
WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus statement Monday: "The violence in northern Ethiopia is pushing an already fragile health system closer to collapse." "As fighting continues, more people are likely to lose access to essential healthcare, including emergency services, maternal and child healthcare and treatment for diseases."
At least 15 people, including several children, killed in drone strikes Friday on a displacement camp in Amhara region. Deaths reported in Rama, Tigray, among people searching for food. Renewed fighting between Tigray rebels and Addis Ababa undermines the November 2022 peace agreement.
